questions.prompt: County records show Black voter registration and officeholding rising after federal enforcement, then declining after enforcement weakened. What is the strongest conclusion?
choices: The pattern is consistent with enforcement affecting political participation, while additional evidence is needed to explain local variation and later decline.
The data prove political equality was permanently secured.
Registration totals measure all dimensions of freedom.
Any later decline proves Reconstruction had no effects.
questions.explanation: The timing supports an enforcement-related hypothesis, but political participation data do not measure all dimensions of freedom or prove a single cause.
